provenance.summary: Measured by the TrueBlink project on 2026-11-14 from 129 SPHEREx Level-2 exposures (257 single-detector measurements: DR1 257; 169 kept), 2025-09-19 to 2026-03-18.
provenance.method: Forced r = 2 px aperture photometry with a local annulus background at the JPL Horizons position for the SPHEREx spacecraft (observer 500@-163182) at mid-exposure, on Level-2 pixels read from the public S3 bucket nasa-irsa-spherex; empirical per-detector aperture correction to r = 4 px; quality cuts on FLAGS (SOURCE and OUTLIER never reject), neighbour and centroid tests.
provenance.release: SPHEREx Level-2 spx_l2b-v27 files; measurements per release: DR1 257
provenance.geometry: Heliocentric distance, distance from SPHEREx and phase angle from JPL Horizons (observer SPHEREx, 500@-163182).
provenance.lightcurve: lightcurve_factor is the rotational brightness factor fitted by our research per visit (period from the light-curve fit); divide flux_mJy by it for a rotation-averaged flux.
provenance.errors: err_mJy is the formal error from the VARIANCE plane plus background; it leaves out rotation and calibration scatter.

units.flux_mJy: mJy, aperture-corrected, not corrected for rotation or geometry
units.flags: OR of Level-2 FLAGS within 2.5 px
